positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: FOMC (7/28-29) is the dominant near-term catalyst for the whole complex. Into the meeting, BTC is firming (~+1.5% on 7/27 toward ~$65k) with spot BTC ETF net inflows (~$69M on 7/22) and dominance holding ~56.6%. On a low-edge, macro-binary day, BTC pairs the day's cleanest institutional bid with the deepest liquidity and lowest volatility = the best downside protection in the universe.
positions.driver: Closed prior BTC at 64432.11 (canonical proxy) for -$2.32 (entry 64446.18, essentially flat). Re-selected BTC as the best risk-adjusted next-24h setup on a fragile, FOMC-risk tape. Wins vs runners-up: ETH (~1884.72) trades as BTC beta and just broke its ETF inflow streak with outflows on 7/24; SOL (~74.91) is the weakest — near the low of its range with spot SOL ETF outflows and no fresh idiosyncratic catalyst. BTC gives the cleanest asymmetric payoff with an 8% major stop and the strongest downside protection ahead of the Fed.
positions.risks: FOMC 7/28-29 is a binary macro risk: a hawkish hold, higher Treasury yields, or renewed tariff/inflation fears could pressure the entire complex; sentiment is fragile and ETF flows have been mixed and could resume bleeding. A break below ~$62.5k would signal the pre-Fed bid is unwinding. Hard stop 59277.54 (-8%, majors rule) caps downside while leaving room below near-term support.
